CREATE TRIGGER "idx_record_log_vec_28_01jd5230vect0rfam1ly000000aa_4_note_9_embedding__i" AFTER INSERT ON record_log_view WHEN NEW.doc_id = '01JD5230VECT0RFAM1LY000000AA' AND NEW._type = 'Note'
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO "idx_record_log_vec_28_01jd5230vect0rfam1ly000000aa_4_note_9_embedding" (rowid, vector) SELECT NEW.rowid, v FROM (SELECT record_log_vec_f32(json_extract(NEW._data, '$.embedding'), 'f32', 8) AS v LIMIT -1) WHERE v IS NOT NULL;
END

CREATE TRIGGER "idx_record_log_vec_28_01jd5230vect0rfam1ly000000aa_4_note_9_embedding__d" AFTER DELETE ON record_log_view WHEN OLD.doc_id = '01JD5230VECT0RFAM1LY000000AA' AND OLD._type = 'Note'
BEGIN
  DELETE FROM "idx_record_log_vec_28_01jd5230vect0rfam1ly000000aa_4_note_9_embedding" WHERE rowid = OLD.rowid;
END
